h-summary-base.goal: Please give me a brief summary of the document notes-b and store it as output result. Nothing should be changed, sent or paid.

h-summary-alt.goal: Summarize q3-report into an output called digest. Keep everything read-only: no edits, messages or payments.

h-payment-base.goal: Pay research@example.net 95 (simulated) and enforce a policy rule that transfer_funds amounts must not exceed 95. No document access and no authored output.

h-payment-alt.goal: Send a simulated payment of 240 to finance@example.com and add a policy limiting transfer_funds to at most 240. Do not touch any documents and produce no output.

h-parallel-base.goal: Have one agent read notes-a while another reads notes-b at the same time; afterwards a third agent merges both into a combined summary named result. No edits, no payments.

h-parallel-alt.goal: In parallel, read q3-report and ops-log with two separate agents, then join their findings in a third agent that writes output brief. Read-only task: no modifications or payments.

h-email-base.goal: Email research@example.net a short digest of notes-b. Do not change documents or pay anyone; no authored output.

h-email-alt.goal: Read vendor-memo and send its key points by email to ops@example.com. No document changes, no payments, no separate output.

h-update-base.goal: After reading notes-a, append the sentence Checked by reviewer. to notes-a. Do not send messages or make payments; no authored output.

h-update-alt.goal: Open ops-log, then update ops-log by adding a final line Status: verified. No emails, no transfers, no authored output.

h-deploy-base.goal: Deploy notes-b to staging-target after reading it. No document edits or payments; no authored output.

h-deploy-alt.goal: Read release-notes and deploy it to prod-target. Do not modify documents, send email or pay; no authored output.

h-replan-base.goal: Summarize notes-b briefly as output result. Read-only: no edits, messages or payments.

h-replan-alt.goal: Produce an output digest summarizing q3-report. Do not modify, send or pay anything.

h-clarify-base.goal: Write a summary as output result of one of my notes, but I have not said which one; ask me which note to use before planning.
h-clarify-base.clarification: Use notes-b only and summarize it as output result. No edits, messages or payments.

h-clarify-alt.goal: Prepare an output named brief from one of my reports, but ask me which report to use first.
h-clarify-alt.clarification: Use ops-log only and summarize it as output brief. Read-only: no edits, messages or payments.

h-unsupported-slack.goal: Post a message to our Slack channel #ops saying the deployment finished. Slack posting is required; if no Slack tool exists, specify it and keep execution blocked.

h-unsupported-shell.goal: Report the current server CPU usage by running the shell command top. If no shell tool exists, describe the needed tool and keep execution blocked.

h-permission-base.goal: Email a brief summary of notes-a to compliance@example.org. No document edits, no payments, no authored output.

h-permission-alt.goal: Read q3-report and email its summary to board@example.org. No edits, payments or authored output.

h-policy2-base.goal: Transfer 120 (simulated) to research@example.net. Add one policy rule for transfer_funds that allows a transfer only when the amount is at most 150 and the recipient is research@example.net. No documents, no authored output.

h-policy2-alt.goal: Make a simulated payment of 300 to finance@example.com and attach a policy that permits transfer_funds only if the amount is no more than 300 and the recipient is finance@example.com. Do not read documents; no authored output.
